The day now ends when you arrive back at the hotel — recommended time at each stop, real walk/metro/DiDi legs, and the trip home. Over-packed evenings and long commutes (e.g. Wulingyuan's mountain roads, Tianmen downtown) both push the end past a sane hour. Fixes suggest how to pull each day back under ~21:30.

admin_panel_settings
Planning access

Invitation required

Planning is available only to invited administrators. Sign in with Google using an approved email address. If you have not been invited, ask a current administrator to add you.

visibilityEveryone can view the complete itinerary. Without administrator access, nothing can be added, removed, moved or saved.
add_location_alt

Add suggestion

Give us the place name. Adding an address, Chinese name or a distinguishing detail helps when several venues share a name. We will verify the location, research the useful details and collect images.

Planning administrators

Administrators can change the itinerary, confirm plans in PostgreSQL, and update the mobile app.
